title: Matchings: Source, Goal and Faithful Companion
summary: Matchings were among the earliest motivations for graph theory. They subsequently remained a central goal, inspiring the development of new mathematical tools that went well beyond problems directly concerning matchings. These tools proved widely applicable, accompanying the growth of graph theory over the past century. A milestone in this trajectory is W.T. Tutte, The factorisation of linear graphs, J. Lond. Math.
